messages:
Nora (PM): quick sketch: inline pool row with min/max, tiny burst pill, and an SLO micro-slider. aim: decisions without opening modal.
Jin (Designer): nice. thought: show a small "burst impact" hint (e.g., ~+10% p95) next to the pill, hover for details. keep it subtle.
Priya (Frontend): hover + keyboard-expand required. add aria-expanded toggle so keyboard users can open details with Enter. also burst pill contrast fails AA in dark theme.
Marco (SRE): the impact numbers must be heuristic by model. recommend "~+10% (est.)" and a tooltip: "Estimate from recent traces for selected model". Dedicated customers behind flag get exact values.
Nora (PM): microcopy options: "Burst available" vs "Burst headroom". short label for the row?
Jin (Designer): "Burst available" reads clear in tight space. for screen readers use aria-label: "Burst available, estimated latency and cost".
Priya (Frontend): warning behavior: when burst == 0 show inline alert: "No burst available 94 spikes may queue" with action "Pick pool with burst". use role=alert.
Marco (SRE): agree. for Dedicated show exact queue headroom number (flagged). ops-bot, create rollout flag ticket.
ops-bot: created INF-5310 (burst-row-flag) assigned to @Marco :white_check_mark:
Jin (Designer): layout nit: min/max steppers crowd the SLO slider on narrow widths. proposal: collapse steppers to a compact inline state under 420px and expand on focus.
Nora (PM): presets for SLO? research liked quick presets + free slider. default to medium preset and allow fine-grain edits.
Marco (SRE): implement presets: chips low/med/high that slider snaps to but remains editable. aria-valuetext should read both percent and preset name when snapped.
Priya (Frontend): add prefers-reduced-motion for slider anims and ensure aria-live announces numeric changes. will prototype keyboard interactions.
Jin (Designer): i'll update mock with: "Burst available" label, relative impact hint, collapsed steppers, alert copy, and visible presets on focus. will include alt text for docs.
Nora (PM): thanks! Priya/Marco can you add effort estimates to INF-5310 by EOD? i'll attach the updated mock. :thumbsup:
Marco (SRE): will add rough ETA by 5pm.
Priya (Frontend): will add frontend tasks and prototype notes to the ticket.
Nora (PM): closing loop 94 landing in next sprint if estimates look good.
